hero.tagline: I want to understand why something works before I trust it.

card.title: MagicIntake
card.body: AI document intake for a law firm. Architecture, pipeline, deploy, and go-to-market — mine.

stats.body: Classification accuracy across roughly 1,200 documents, replacing a fully manual intake process.
Independent implementations of one circuit, built to separate failures of the logic from failures of the implementation.
Discovery interviews on Casos before a line of code was written. The schema came out of them.

caseStudy.title: MagicIntake
caseStudy.body: A law firm was reading and sorting every incoming document by hand. I designed the architecture, wrote the pipeline, deployed it, and ran the go-to-market. It classifies at roughly 97% accuracy across about 1,200 documents.

callout.label: The decision I would defend
callout.body: Tenant isolation is enforced by row-level security in Postgres, not by application code. The database refuses the query. Application bugs cannot leak another firm's file.

sevenSegment.title: 7-Segment Alphanumeric Display
sevenSegment.body: A four-character display, derived by hand from truth tables and Karnaugh maps, then built three separate ways to find out which failures belonged to the logic and which belonged to the implementation.

image.alt: Basys 3 board displaying four characters, resting on the handwritten Karnaugh maps it was derived from
image.caption: The board, on the notes it came from

figure.label: Figure 02 · diagram slot
figure.note: the same derivation redrawn — truth table → K-map → segment equation, one segment highlighted end to end.
figure.caption: Left: the sheet the equations were reduced on. Right: the same work, redrawn to read.

stages.label: STAGE 01
stages.title: Derivation by hand
stages.body: Truth tables for every character, then Karnaugh maps to reduce each segment to its minimal expression. No generator, no library.

stages.label: STAGE 02
stages.title: NAND only
stages.body: Rebuilt on a breadboard using nothing but NAND gates, to prove the expressions held under a universal gate.

stages.label: STAGE 03
stages.title: Standard gates
stages.body: The same logic in AND, OR, and NOT. Different chip count, different wiring faults, identical behavior.

stages.label: STAGE 04
stages.title: VHDL on silicon
stages.body: Written in VHDL, synthesized in Vivado, running on a Basys 3 FPGA. The toolchain agreed with the paper.

image.alt: Basys 3 FPGA board displaying four characters

control.label: Stage 05 · the control
control.title: Rebuilt in redstone
control.body: Then I built the same circuit again in Minecraft, out of redstone, to confirm the logic held independently of any toolchain. If it works in a game engine's crude gate model, the derivation was never the problem.

items.title: Casos
items.body: Two-sided marketplace for ABA therapy staffing. A structured-fields-only schema keeps the platform outside PHI scope by design rather than by policy.

items.title: Magic Box
items.body: Arduino Nano and C++. A 3×3 keypad matrix, nine LEDs, hand-soldered, in an enclosure I designed and printed.

items.title: Power-plant siting
items.body: SQL to Pandas to Tableau over 2,500+ records with Intel, ranking candidate sites as executive dashboards.

dimensions.label: Clinical
dimensions.body: Registered Behavior Technician delivering in-home therapy to children with autism. It is where I learned to measure behavior before interpreting it.

dimensions.label: Commercial
dimensions.body: I ran my own go-to-market: cold outreach, demos, pricing, and the paperwork. The LLC exists because a customer said yes.

dimensions.label: Range
dimensions.body: From Boolean algebra on a breadboard to production infrastructure. Bilingual in English and Spanish, in Miami.
